source: src/parser/configParser.ts parseDocument; src/parser/configParser.ts findNodeRangeForDeletion; src/parser/configParser.ts findArrayInsertionPoint; src/api/formatJson.ts prettyPrintJsonIfPossible
title: Config parser and JSON edit primitives: parse, delete range, insert point, pretty print
scenario: 1) parseDocument on '{"entityTypes":[{"uri":"configuration/entityTypes/A",},]}' (trailing commas). 2) parseDocument('') and parseDocument('   '), then UriIndex.build. 3) findNodeRangeForDeletion on 3-element and 1-element arrays (LF and CRLF), apply, JSON-parse. 4) findArrayInsertionPoint for empty, populated, missing and object paths. 5) prettyPrintJsonIfPossible on minified JSON, leading BOM, empty, whitespace and '{"a":'.
expected: 1) ast is a non-null node, model.entityTypes[0].uri set, errors list trailing commas, no throw. 2) model is {}, no exception, UriIndex.build runs. 3) Result always valid JSON with the remaining elements, no dangling comma, sole delete keeps brackets. 4) Empty: offset at closing bracket, isEmpty true; populated: after last element, isEmpty false; missing or non-array: -1, isEmpty true. 5) Valid input becomes 2-space JSON with one trailing newline and no BOM; empty, whitespace, invalid (and JSONC) input returned unchanged without throwing.

source: src/commands/editCommands.ts deleteNode / renameNode; src/commands/elementSkeletons.ts nextDefaultLabel / build*Object
title: Edit commands: minimal WorkspaceEdits, read-only lifecycleActions, labels, skeletons
scenario: 1) With the vscode stub, run renameNode on an entity type and deleteNode on an array element after the confirm prompt returns 'Delete'. 2) Cancel the confirm and rename with an unchanged name. 3) Call deleteNode and renameNode on a lifecycleActions tree item. 4) nextDefaultLabel('EntityType', ['EntityType1','EntityType7','Other']) and a prefix with regex characters; build every skeleton (entity, relation, grouping, graph, hierarchy, interaction, source, match group, survivorship, cleanse).
expected: 1) Captured WorkspaceEdit holds only a range delete or label+uri replacements (new uri keeps prefix, swaps last segment); no range spans the whole document (CLAUDE.md invariant). 2) Returns false with no edit. 3) Both return false, show 'lifecycleActions is read-only' and apply no edit. 4) Label 'EntityType8'; each skeleton has uri 'configuration/<family>/<label>' and its mandatory fields. The stub may need applyEdit support.

source: src/ontology/modelToGraph.ts buildGraphModel; src/ontology/layoutPersistence.ts applyLayout / loadLayout; src/ontology/webviewMessageSafety.ts, src/ontology/inspectorHtml.ts; src/webview/ontologyView.ts is excluded from tsc and coverage
title: Ontology graph model, saved layout and webview pure-logic safety
scenario: 1) buildGraphModel on the canonical fixture (scripts/lib/load-canonical-fixture.cjs). 2) Model with two relationTypes between X and Y, a Reference attribute X->Y, a self-reference on X and a relationType missing endObject. 3) applyLayout with complete, partial and empty maps; loadLayout with version 2, malformed JSON and a valid file (memory-fs). 4) isTrustedMessageOrigin with a mismatched origin; createKeyedMap with '__proto__'; renderAttrTree/renderRelTypeTree with '' and quotes.
expected: 1) Node ids are unique URI tail names; every edge source/target is a node id; attribute counts equal simple+nested+ref per type. 2) One 'conn-X-Y' edge with 2 relationshipLabels and 1 referenceLabel ('Connected with 2 relation types'); self-reference and incomplete relation yield no edge; extends edge id 'extends-<id>-<parent>'. 3) Complete map applied with x/y copied; partial returns applied false and the original graph; bad version or JSON gives undefined; layout file swaps '.reltio.json' for '.reltio.layout.json'. 4) Foreign origin rejected; '__proto__' stored as an own key; all dynamic values HTML-escaped.

title: Match verification refuses configFile traversal and outside-workspace paths
scenario: 1) Requests with configFile '../outside/x.json', 'a/../../b.json', 'C:\other\x.json', '/etc/passwd' and a valid 'tenant\BusinessConfig.json', with an injected verify spy.
expected: 1) The first four return failed/invalid-request with the 'inside the workspace' message and the spy is never called; the valid path resolves with backslashes and case normalised.

source: src/navigation/uriIndex.ts UriIndex.build; src/navigation/uriIndex.ts getAllUnresolved / isPlatformHostedConfigurationUri; src/navigation/uriIndex.ts buildVirtualDefinitions / graftAttributes; src/navigation/uriIndex.ts buildOutputMappingRefDefinitions
title: UriIndex: rebuild reset, unresolved filtering, virtual URIs and outputMapping refs
scenario: 1) Build from document A (definitions, references, virtual definitions), then build() with small document B. 2) Document with referenceConfigurationURI 'configuration/_vertical/foo' and dangling 'configuration/entityTypes/Missing'. 3) Entity A with a Reference attribute to B, plus cyclic A->B->A and a 7-hop chain. 4) Cleanse mapping with inline outputMapping array and a reference ending '/outputMapping'.
expected: 1) Only B's entries remain in definitions, virtualDefinitions and references. 2) getAllUnresolved returns only the Missing reference (one per referencing node). 3) getDefinition('<refAttrUri>/attributes/<name>') resolves to B's attribute and getRealUri maps back; cycles and long chains terminate (MAX_VIRTUAL_DEPTH 5). 4) virtualDefinitions holds the ref URI with realUri = mapping URI; getDefinitionNode returns the outputMapping array value node.

title: vscode-stub: unresolved-URI diagnostics severity and auto-save triggers
scenario: 1) DiagnosticsManager.update() on an index with one unresolved URI under reltio.unresolvedUriSeverity 'warning', 'error', 'off' and an unknown value. 2) Auto-save with autoSaveOnEditorSwitch (default true) and autoSaveOnWindowBlur (default false): fire onDidChangeActiveTextEditor with dirty a.reltio.json, notes.json and path\L3.json; then window blur and focus-gain.
expected: 1) warning/error: one 'Unresolved URI: <uri>' diagnostic, source 'reltio', matching severity, range excludes quotes; 'off': empty list; unknown falls back to Warning. 2) Saves only .reltio.json and L3.json docs; disabled editor-switch setting skips; blur saves nothing unless enabled and ignores focus-gain. If the stub lacks DiagnosticCollection or event emitters, run as manual (Tier C).

source: src/workspace/configurationHistory.ts historySnapshotFileName / tryParseHistorySnapshotName; src/workspace/configurationHistory.ts writeHistorySnapshot / listLocalHistorySnapshots / clearHistoryDirectory
title: Configuration history snapshots: filename sanitizing, file body, listing and clearing
scenario: 1) historySnapshotFileName with updatedBy 'a/b:c*?', a 200-char name, empty and missing; parse names back; malformed names 'L3-x.reltio.json' and non-digit timestamp. 2) With memory-fs write two entries with different timestamps and rewrite one; add a stray file and a subfolder; list; clear.
expected: 1) Illegal characters become '_', length capped at 80, empty becomes 'unknown'; parse returns the same timestamp; malformed names return undefined. 2) Body is JSON.stringify(configuration, null, tab) plus newline; rewrite is idempotent; list is newest first and ignores non-snapshot names; clear removes files but keeps subfolders; missing directory yields [] without throwing.

title: Velocity pack manifest byte counts and assets bundle versions consistent
scenario: 1) Reuse validateVelocityPacks, then check declared bytes equal statSync size of each BusinessConfig.json and that the assets JSON has non-empty skillsBundleVersion and velocityPacksBundleVersion.
expected: 1) Per-pack declared bytes equal file size, with the failing pack id named; both version fields present.

source: src/parser/configParser.ts + src/navigation/uriIndex.ts (rebuildUriIndex sequence in src/extension.ts); src/commands/editCommands.ts insertAttribute / insertMatchGroup
title: Edit workflows: re-index after edit and insert into a missing optional array
scenario: 1) Parse fixture, apply a text edit adding an entity type and a reference to it, re-run parseDocument and UriIndex.build (the rebuildUriIndex sequence); then remove the definition. 2) Entity type with no 'attributes' or 'matchGroups': run insertAttribute (Nested) and insertMatchGroup with the stub applying the WorkspaceEdit.
expected: 1) New URI resolves via getDefinition, getReferences lists it, getAllUnresolved no longer reports it; removing the definition makes it unresolved again. 2) Result is valid JSON with a new array holding one skeleton with the parent URI prefix and label 'Attribute1' or 'MatchGroup1'; other properties and formatting unchanged.

title: Entity browser and ontology panel open and render for a configuration
scenario: 1) In the Extension Development Host open the ontology graph and an entity detail view from a *.reltio.json; drag a node, reopen, inspect an entity with attributes. Webview UI cannot run under the node stub.
expected: 1) Graph renders nodes and edges, the dragged layout persists in *.reltio.layout.json after reopen, the inspector lists attributes, no console errors.

title: Security: untrusted token and host handling, history filenames stay in folder
scenario: 1) Verify spy with no token, GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN sentinel, UntrustedHostError, network error and non-object body. 2) historySnapshotFileName with updatedBy '..\..\evil', '../x', 'a|b' and a numeric timestamp.
expected: 1) No outbound call for missing or sentinel token (signed-out); UntrustedHostError becomes failed/untrusted-host; network error becomes failed/network; handleVerificationRequest never throws. 2) Name has no path separators or reserved characters so joinPath stays in historyDir and still ends .reltio.json.

source: src/parser/configParser.ts + src/navigation/uriIndex.ts (compare scripts/bench-format-json.cjs); src/api/formatJson.ts; scripts/bench-format-json.cjs; src/ontology/modelToGraph.ts buildGraphModel
title: Performance and scale: parse+index, pretty-print and graph build on large inputs
scenario: 1) Clone fixture entityTypes to about 2000 types and 50k attributes; time parseDocument + UriIndex.build over 5 runs. 2) prettyPrintJsonIfPossible on 1x, 10x and 40x replicated fixture text. 3) buildGraphModel with 1000 entity types, each with a Reference attribute, plus 1000 relationTypes.
expected: 1) Each pass within a generous CI budget (for example under 2s) and definitions equal the type count; fails if index build turns quadratic. 2) 40x takes at most about 80x the 1x time; output equals JSON.stringify(parse, null, 2) plus newline. 3) Under 1s, 1000 nodes, edges deduped per sorted pair, no duplicate edge ids.

source: src/workspace/l3Discovery.ts relativeParts; src/workspace/matchVerification.ts normalizedPath; src/commands/editCommands.ts, src/parser/configParser.ts
title: Windows path/case handling and CRLF/tab preservation in edits
scenario: 1) deriveTenantNamings with root 'c:/Repo' and files under 'C:/repo/DP/x', platform stubbed to win32 and linux; resolveConfigFile with backslashes and mixed case. 2) Apply deletion ranges and inserted blocks to a CRLF and a tab-indented fixture variant; parse the result.
expected: 1) win32/darwin: case-insensitive trim gives folder rows ['DP']; linux strict; matchVerification accepts backslash and mixed-case paths inside the root. 2) Result valid JSON, other lines keep original line endings, insertion indent follows the parent property indent.
